text:
maria: Quick thread — finalizing benchmark narrative for launch/webinar.
jon: Data snapshot: median p50 45ms, p95 320ms, cost/token $0.0006. I'll attach CSV in #data later.
sasha: Want this to be: "Fast where it matters, cheap at scale" — need chart combo: p95 tail + tokens/$ across models.
lucas: Two-panel idea: left = latency CDF (p50/90/95 lines), right = cost per 1k tokens bar by model. Clean axes, no log if we use percentiles.
maria: Love that. Also need one small inset showing throughput (req/s) at 8k context to highlight dedicated vs hosted.
olivia: CTA routing: webinar signups -> nurture cadence; tier folks >50k tokens/month route to AE. Can we flag with utm=bench_prospect?
jon: Method blurb: benchmark run on identical hardware (A10G), batch=1/4/16, sequence lengths 256/1024. We'll include snippet: ```bench --models m1,m2 --seq 256,1024 --batches 1,4,16``` 
maria: Copy blurb for social: "See how serving choices change your latency tail and your token bill — live demo at the webinar." Shorten if needed.
sasha: We should call out graceful degradation: show fallback model that keeps p95 bounded. One small callout box: "Fallbacks keep app online when capacity spikes." 
lucas: Design note: make latency CDF colored by model family; dotted lines for canary variants. Keep legend short.
olivia: For AB tests: Variation A emphasizes latency, Variation B emphasizes cost savings. We'll run to: paid social -> A, organic -> B, email -> both.
jon: Data transparency: include appendix with raw numbers and how quantization affected cost. Also add margin-of-error note for sampling.
maria: @jon can you drop the final CSV + 2 PNGs by EOD so I can hand to design?
jon: On it. I'll upload to /shared/benchmarks/5532109999/
bench-bot: upload complete: /shared/benchmarks/5532109999/summary.csv
maria: Thanks — final asks: 1) One-sentence lead line for header (shoot me 1-2 options), 2) short methodology blurb (1 para), 3) three CTAs mapped to inbound tags. 
sasha: Header option: "Latency where it matters. Cost that scales." Alt: "Serve smarter: reduce tails, shrink bills."
maria: Perfect. I'll queue copy. Anyone object to webinar demo flow: 1) quick benchmark walkthrough, 2) live config toggles (batch/quantize), 3) Q&A + customer mini-case?
olivia: Sounds good. Add a 5-min segment at end to capture AE-qualifying Qs.
lucas: I'll mock slide comps tomorrow AM.
jon: Uploaded PNGs now.
maria: Awesome. If no other blockers I'll iterate assets and post draft in #marketing for final signoff at 2pm PST.
olivia: :thumbsup:
sasha: +1
jon: +1
lucas: +1
maria: Thanks team — moving to action.
